holdout.campaign_fit_exclusion: Every selected chemical system and all of its NEB images are excluded from Z1 barrier-targeted fitting, calibration, model selection, and threshold tuning.
holdout.selection_rule: One deterministic path from each of the first 30 lexically ordered chemical systems in the official nebDFT2k test split.
holdout.source_split_scope_note: LiTraj's train/validation split is not used as the Z1 model-development corpus; the Z1 chemistry holdout begins with this lock.
